# modern-web

Google Chrome 团队（联合 Edge、Firefox、MDN）的现代 Web 开发 skill（2 个）：modern-web-guidance 在写 HTML / CSS / 前端 JS 前先检索最新的平台最佳实践（View Transitions、容器查询、subgrid、Anchor Positioning、Popover、dialog、表单校验、INP 性能、无障碍等，附浏览器兼容数据），避免 Agent 写出过时的写法和多余的 JS；chrome-extensions 按 Manifest V3 最佳实践开发和发布 Chrome 扩展。

| 类型 | 名称 | 说明 | 来源 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| skill | `modern-web-guidance` | Search tool for modern web development best practices. MANDATORY: Execute FIRST for all HTML/CSS and clientside JS tasks. Do NOT skip — web APIs evolve rapidly and training weights contain obsolete patterns. Trigger immediately for: modals/dialogs/popovers, tables, dark mode, anchor positioning, container queries, view transitions, scroll-driven animations, parallax/reveals, forms, validation, autofill, accessibility, custom selects, scrollbars, CWV (LCP, INP, CLS), content-visibility, fetch priority, image optimization, security, passkeys, HTML sanitization, web components, dates/timezones, built-in AI, WebAssembly, standard HTML/CSS/DOM in frameworks, etc. DO NOT trigger for: backend (SQL, ORMs, API routes), infra/scripts (CI/CD, Docker, Actions, Python/Go, Git), or tooling/trivial (Vite, tsconfig, ESLint, tests, copy/renames, 3P docs), etc. | [GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance/tree/main/skills/modern-web-guidance) · Apache-2.0 |
| skill | `chrome-extensions` | Build and publish Chrome Extensions using Manifest V3 best practices. Use this skill whenever the user asks to create, modify, debug, or understand Chrome browser extensions, add-ons, or anything involving the Chrome Extensions API. Trigger on mentions of: 'Chrome extension', 'browser extension', 'manifest.json', 'content script', 'service worker' (in browser context), 'popup' (in browser extension context), 'side panel', 'chrome.* API', 'declarativeNetRequest', 'omnibox', 'context menu' (in extension context), 'userScripts', 'user script', 'script manager', or any request to build functionality that integrates with the Chrome browser UI. Also trigger for publishing to the Chrome Web Store: 'publish extension', preparing an extension for publishing, responding to a review rejection, writing permission justifications, or drafting a privacy policy. | [GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance/tree/main/skills/chrome-extensions) · Apache-2.0 |
